	original_tag = SWE
	IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
	check_variable = {
		ruling_party = 15
	}
	NOT = {
		OR = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_regime_democratic_socialist
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_regime_independent_communist
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_regime_moscow_communist
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_regime_maoist
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_regime_corporatist_far_right
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_regime_security_nationalist
		}
	}
	has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_office_falldin
}

	OR = {
		has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_delivered_mobility
		AND = {
			set_temp_variable = {
				COLDWAR_SWE_national_required_budget = {
					value = gdp_total
					multiply = 0.005
				}
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = treasury
				value = COLDWAR_SWE_national_required_budget
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
	}
}

		has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_delivered_job_guarantee

			check_variable = {
				var = treasury

			}
		}
	}
	OR = {
		has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_national_project_job_guarantee
		33 = {
			is_owned_by = ROOT

			free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 include_locked = no }
		}
	}
}

		has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_delivered_regime_maoist_petitions
		AND = {
			set_temp_variable = {
				COLDWAR_SWE_national_required_budget = {
					value = gdp_total
					multiply = 0.002
				}
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = treasury
				value = COLDWAR_SWE_national_required_budget
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
	}
}

				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
	}
}
